title.zh: 卷四十八 唐書24: 末帝本紀下
title.en: Volume 48 Book of Later Tang 24: Later Emperors Annals 3
title.raw: 卷四十八 唐書24: 末帝本紀下 Volume 48 Book of Later Tang 24: Later Emperors Annals 3

sentences.zh: 清泰三年春正月辛卯朔，帝御文明殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qingtai, spring, first month, on the xinmao day, the first of the month, the Emperor presided in the Hall of Civilization to receive court congratulations, with guards and honors as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the New Year's day of the first month of the third year of Qingtai, the Emperor went to the Hall of Civilization to receive court congratulations, with guards and ceremonial escort according to custom.

sentences.zh: 乙未，百濟遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Baekje sent envoys presenting native products.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Baekje sent envoys with tributary goods.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸龍門佛寺祈雪。

translations.literal: On wuxu, he visited Longmen Buddhist Temple to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Emperor visited Longmen Buddhist Temple to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以給事中、充樞密院直學士呂琦為端明殿學士；

translations.literal: On guimao, Lü Qi, Supervising Secretary and acting direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness;
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Lü Qi, Supervising Secretary and acting direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness;

sentences.zh: 以六軍諸衛判官、尚書工部郎中薛文遇為樞密院直學士。

translations.literal: Xue Wenyü, judge of the Six Armies and Palace Guards and Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works, was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: and Xue Wenyü, judge of the Six Armies and Palace Guards and Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works, was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以上元夜京城張燈，帝微行，置酒於趙延壽之第。

translations.literal: On yisi, because on the Lantern Festival night the capital hung lamps, the Emperor went out incognito and set out wine at Zhao Yanshou's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, when the capital was hung with lanterns for the Lantern Festival, the Emperor went out incognito and held a banquet at Zhao Yanshou's mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁未，皇子河南尹、判六軍諸衛事重美封雍王。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the imperial prince Chongmei, Henan Intendant and overseer of the Six Armies and Palace Guards, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the imperial prince Chongmei, who was Henan Intendant and overseer of the Six Armies and Palace Guards, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yong.

sentences.zh: 己未，以前司農卿王彥鎔為太僕卿。

translations.literal: On jiwei, former Director of the Directorate of Foodstuffs Wang Yanrong was made Director of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei former Director of the Directorate of Foodstuffs Wang Yanrong was appointed Director of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，吐渾寧朔兩府留後李可久加檢校司徒。

translations.literal: Second month, wuchen: Li Kejiu, acting commissioner of the Tuyuhun Ningshuo two prefectures, was given the additional title of Honorary Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen, Li Kejiu, acting commissioner of the Tuyuhun Ningshuo two prefectures, was given the additional title of Honorary Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 可久本姓白氏，前朝賜姓。

translations.literal: Kejiu was originally surnamed Bai; the previous dynasty bestowed a surname on him.
translations.idiomatic: Kejiu had originally borne the surname Bai; the previous dynasty had granted him a new surname.

sentences.zh: 庚午，監修國史姚顗，史官張昭遠、李祥、吳承範等修撰《明宗實錄》三十卷上之。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Yao Yan, overseer of the national history, and the historiographers Zhang Zhaoyuan, Li Xiang, Wu Chengfan, and others completed and presented thirty juan of the 《Veritable Records of Emperor Mingzong》.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yao Yan, overseer of the national history, together with historiographers Zhang Zhaoyuan, Li Xiang, Wu Chengfan, and others, presented thirty juan of the 《Veritable Records of Emperor Mingzong》.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：同修撰官中書舍人張昭遠、李祥，直館左拾遺吳承範，右拾遺楊昭儉等各頒賚有差。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》: the co-compilers, Secretariat Drafters Zhang Zhaoyuan and Li Xiang, Left Reminder Wu Chengfan of the Historiography Office, Right Reminder Yang Zhaojian, and others each received graded rewards.)]
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》 records that the co-compilers, Secretariat Drafters Zhang Zhaoyuan and Li Xiang, Left Reminder Wu Chengfan of the Historiography Office, Right Reminder Yang Zhaojian, and others each received graded rewards.)]

sentences.zh: 以大理卿竇維為光祿卿，以前許州節度判官張登為大理卿。

translations.literal: Dou Wei, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments; Zhang Deng, former military administrator of Xuzhou circuit, was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Wei, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and Zhang Deng, former military administrator of Xuzhou circuit, was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以太常卿李鈴為兵部尚書，以兵部尚書梁文矩為太常卿。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Ling was made Minister of War; Minister of War Liang Wenju was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Ling was appointed Minister of War, and Minister of War Liang Wenju was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以前鄜州節度使皇甫立為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, former military governor of Binzhou circuit Huangfu Li was made military governor of Luzhou circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen former military governor of Binzhou circuit Huangfu Li was appointed military governor of Luzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以前均州刺史仇暉為左威衛上將軍，保順軍節度使鮑君福加檢校太尉、同平章事。

translations.literal: On xinsi, former prefect of Junzhou Qiu Hui was made General-in-chief of the Left Majestic Guard; Bao Junfu, military governor of Baoshun army, was given the additional titles of Honorary Grand General and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi former prefect of Junzhou Qiu Hui was made General-in-chief of the Left Majestic Guard, and Bao Junfu, military governor of the Baoshun army, was given the additional titles of Honorary Grand General and Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以昭義節度使安元信卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On dinghai, because Zhaoyi circuit military governor An Yuanxin died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai court was suspended upon the death of Zhaoyi circuit military governor An Yuanxin.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，中書門下奏：「 準閣門分析內外官辭見謝規例：諸州判官、軍將進奉到闕，舊例門見門辭；

translations.literal: Third month, gengzi: the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "Pursuant to the Gate Office's analysis of regulations for farewells, audiences, and thanks by inner and outer officials: when circuit judges and military commissioners arrive at court with tribute, the old rule was audience at the gate and farewell at the gate;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the third month the Secretariat and Chancellery reported: "Following the Gate Office's analysis of rules for farewells, audiences, and expressions of thanks by inner and outer officials: when circuit judges and military commissioners arrived at court with tribute, the old practice required an audience at the gate and a farewell at the gate;

sentences.zh: 今後隻令朝見，依舊門辭。

translations.literal: hereafter they are only to have a court audience, with farewell at the gate as before.
translations.idiomatic: henceforth they are only to have a court audience, with farewell at the gate as before.

sentences.zh: 新除諸道判官、書記以下無例中謝，並放謝放辭，得替到京無例見；

translations.literal: Newly appointed circuit judges and secretaries and below had no precedent for mid-court thanks; all were excused from thanks and farewells, and when replaced and arriving at the capital had no precedent for an audience;
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed circuit judges, secretaries, and those below them had no precedent for mid-court thanks; all were excused from thanks and farewells, and when replaced and arriving at the capital had no precedent for an audience;

sentences.zh: 今後兩使判官許中謝，赴任即門辭，其書記以下並依舊例。

translations.literal: hereafter military administrators of the two commissioners are permitted mid-court thanks; upon taking office they have farewell at the gate; secretaries and below follow the old rule.
translations.idiomatic: henceforth military administrators of the two commissioners are permitted mid-court thanks; upon taking office they take leave at the gate; secretaries and below follow the old rule.

sentences.zh: 朝臣文五品、武四品以上舊例中謝，其以下無例對謝；

translations.literal: Court officials of civil rank 5 and above and military rank 4 and above had the old rule of mid-court thanks; those below had no precedent for facing thanks;
translations.idiomatic: Court officials of civil rank 5 and above and military rank 4 and above had the old rule of mid-court thanks; those below had no precedent for facing thanks;

sentences.zh: 今請依天成四年正月敕，凡升朝官並許中謝。

translations.literal: we now ask that pursuant to the first-month edict of the fourth year of Tiancheng, all court-attending officials be permitted mid-court thanks.
translations.idiomatic: we now ask that, pursuant to the first-month edict of the fourth year of Tiancheng, all court-attending officials be permitted mid-court thanks.

sentences.zh: 諸道都押衙、馬步都指揮、虞候、鎮將、諸色場院，無例謝辭，並進榜子放謝放辭，得替到闕，無例入見。

translations.literal: Circuit chief military adjutants, cavalry and infantry commanders, military inspectors, garrison commanders, and various field offices had no precedent for thanks and farewells; all submitted memorials and were excused from thanks and farewells; when replaced and arriving at court, there was no precedent for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit chief military adjutants, cavalry and infantry commanders, military inspectors, garrison commanders, and various field offices had no precedent for thanks and farewells; all submitted memorials and were excused from thanks and farewells; when replaced and arriving at court, there was no precedent for an audience.

sentences.zh: 在京鹽曲稅官、兩官巡即許中謝，新除令、錄並中謝，次日門辭，兼有口敕誡勵。

translations.literal: Salt and liquor tax officials in the capital and inspectors of the two offices are permitted mid-court thanks; newly appointed magistrates and recorders all have mid-court thanks, farewell at the gate the next day, and also receive oral edicts of admonition and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Salt and liquor tax officials in the capital and inspectors of the two offices are permitted mid-court thanks; newly appointed magistrates and recorders all receive mid-court thanks, take leave at the gate the next day, and also receive oral edicts of admonition and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 文武兩班所差吊祭使及告廟祠祭，隻正衙辭，不赴內殿。

translations.literal: Mourning and sacrificial envoys dispatched from the civil and military cohorts take leave only at the main court, and do not go to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning and sacrificial envoys dispatched from the civil and military cohorts take leave only at the main court and do not go to the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 諸道進奏官到闕，見，得假，進榜子門辭。

translations.literal: Circuit memorial presenters arriving at court have an audience, receive leave, submit a memorial, and take leave at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit memorial presenters arriving at court have an audience, receive leave, submit a memorial, and take leave at the gate.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，權知福建節度使王昶奏，節度使王延鈞以去年十月十四日卒。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Wang Chang, acting military governor of Fujian circuit, memorialized that military governor Wang Yanjun died on the fourteenth day of the tenth month of last year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wang Chang, acting military governor of Fujian circuit, reported that military governor Wang Yanjun had died on the fourteenth day of the tenth month of the previous year.

sentences.zh: 是時延鈞父子雖僭竊於閩嶺，猶稱藩於朝廷，故有是奏。

translations.literal: At that time, although Yanjun and his son had usurped rule in the Min ranges, they still called themselves vassals of the court; hence this memorial.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, although Yanjun and his son had seized power in the Min ranges, they still styled themselves vassals of the court; hence this report.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以右神武統軍楊漢章為彰武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Yang Hanzhang, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, was made military governor of the Zhangwu army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yang Hanzhang, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, was appointed military governor of the Zhangwu army.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以翰林學士、禮部侍郎馬裔孫為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Rites Ma Yisun was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Rites Ma Yisun was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以端明殿學士呂琦為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Lü Qi, academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness, was made Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Lü Qi, academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness, was appointed Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: （案《通鑒》：呂琦與李崧建和親契丹之策，為薛文遇所沮，改為御史中丞，蓋疏之也。）〉

translations.literal: (Per the 《Comprehensive Mirror》: Lü Qi and Li Song proposed a policy of alliance with the Khitan by marriage; blocked by Xue Wenyu, he was changed to Censor-in-chief, likely to distance him.)]
translations.idiomatic: (Per the 《Comprehensive Mirror》, Lü Qi and Li Song had proposed an alliance with the Khitan through marriage; thwarted by Xue Wenyu, Lü was reassigned as Censor-in-chief, likely to push him aside.)]

sentences.zh: 戊午，御史中丞盧損責授右讚善大夫，知雜侍御史韋稅責授太僕寺丞，侍御史魏遜責授太府寺主簿，侍御史王嶽責授司農寺主簿。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Censor-in-chief Lu Sun was demoted to Right Mentor; supervising censor Wei Shui was demoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Stud; attendant censor Wei Xun was demoted to Registrar of the Imperial Treasury; attendant censor Wang Yue was demoted to Registrar of the Directorate of Foodstuffs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Censor-in-chief Lu Sun was demoted to Right Mentor; supervising censor Wei Shui to Vice Director of the Imperial Stud; attendant censor Wei Xun to Registrar of the Imperial Treasury; and attendant censor Wang Yue to Registrar of the Directorate of Foodstuffs.

sentences.zh: 初，延州保安鎮將白文審聞兵興岐下，專殺郡人趙思謙等十餘人，已伏其罪，復下台追係推鞫，未竟。

translations.literal: Earlier, Bai Wenshen, garrison commander of Bao'an in Yanzhou, hearing that war had risen below Qi, had on his own killed more than ten local men including Zhao Siqian; he had confessed his crime, but was again sent down to the censorate for pursuit, detention, and interrogation, which was not yet concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Bai Wenshen, garrison commander of Bao'an in Yanzhou, hearing that war had broken out in the Qi region, had on his own authority killed more than ten local men including Zhao Siqian. He had confessed, but was sent back to the censorate for detention and interrogation before the case was finished.

sentences.zh: 會去年五月十二日德音，除十惡五逆、放火殺人外並放。

translations.literal: It happened that the amnesty edict of the twelfth day of the fifth month of last year released all except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, arson, and murder.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that an amnesty edict of the twelfth day of the fifth month of the previous year had released all prisoners except those guilty of the ten abominations, the five rebellions, arson, or murder.

sentences.zh: 盧損輕易即破械釋文審，帝大怒，收文審誅之。

translations.literal: Lu Sun lightly broke his fetters and released Wenshen; the Emperor was greatly angered, seized Wenshen, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Sun rashly had his shackles removed and released Wenshen. The Emperor was furious, had Wenshen seized, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 台司稱奉德音釋放，不得追領祗證。

translations.literal: The censorate said that pursuant to the amnesty edict he was released and could not be pursued to produce witnesses.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate argued that under the amnesty edict he had been released and could not be pursued to produce witnesses.

sentences.zh: 中書詰雲，德音言「不在追窮枝蔓」，無「不得追領祗證」六字，擅改敕語。

translations.literal: The Secretariat questioned them, saying the amnesty edict read "without pursuing extended branches," and had no six characters "may not pursue to produce witnesses"—they had altered the edict language on their own.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat challenged them: the amnesty edict read "without pursuing extended branches," and contained no phrase "may not pursue to produce witnesses"—they had altered the edict on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 大理斷以失出罪人論，故有是命。

translations.literal: The Court of Judicial Review judged it under the statute on releasing convicted persons in error; hence these orders.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Judicial Review judged the matter under the statute on wrongly releasing convicted persons; hence these demotions.

sentences.zh: 是月，有蛇鼠鬥於師子門外，鼠生而蛇死。

translations.literal: That month, a snake and a rat fought outside the Lion Gate; the rat lived and the snake died.
translations.idiomatic: That month a snake and a rat fought outside the Lion Gate; the rat survived and the snake died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未朔，以左衛上將軍王景戡為左神武統軍，以右領軍上將軍李頃為華清宮使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day on jiwei: General-in-chief of the Left Guard Wang Jingzhan was made commander of the Left Divine Martial Army; General-in-chief of the Right Metropolitan Guard Li Qing was made commissioner of Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, General-in-chief of the Left Guard Wang Jingzhan was appointed commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, and General-in-chief of the Right Metropolitan Guard Li Qing was made commissioner of Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以太子詹事盧演為工部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Lu Yan, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Minister of Works and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Lu Yan, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Minister of Works and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以中書舍人、史館修撰張昭遠為禮部侍郎；

translations.literal: On xinwei, Zhang Zhaoyuan, Secretariat Drafter and compiler of the Historiography Office, was made Vice Minister of Rites;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhang Zhaoyuan, Secretariat Drafter and compiler of the Historiography Office, was appointed Vice Minister of Rites;

sentences.zh: 以前滄州節度使李金全為右領軍上將軍。

translations.literal: former military governor of Cangzhou circuit Li Jinquan was made General-in-chief of the Right Metropolitan Guard.
translations.idiomatic: and former military governor of Cangzhou circuit Li Jinquan was made General-in-chief of the Right Metropolitan Guard.

sentences.zh: 是月，有熊入京城捕人。

translations.literal: That month, a bear entered the capital and seized people.
translations.idiomatic: That month a bear entered the capital and attacked people.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，以河東節度使、兼大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管、檢校太師、兼中書令、駙馬都尉石敬瑭為鄆州節度使，進封趙國公。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinmao: Shi Jingtang, military governor of Hedong circuit, concurrently overall commander of the Tangut and Han cavalry and infantry of the Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies, Honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Grand Secretary, and Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law, was made military governor of Yanzhou circuit and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the fifth month Shi Jingtang, military governor of Hedong circuit and overall commander of the Tangut and Han forces of the northern border armies, Honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Grand Secretary, and Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law, was appointed military governor of Yanzhou circuit and advanced in rank to Duke of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 以河陽節度使、充侍衛馬步軍都指揮使宋審虔為河東節度使。

translations.literal: Song Shenqian, military governor of Heyang circuit and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry and infantry, was made military governor of Hedong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shenqian, military governor of Heyang circuit and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry and infantry, was appointed military governor of Hedong circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以前晉州節度使、大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢副總管張敬達充西北面蕃漢馬步都部署，落副總管。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Zhang Jingda, former military governor of Jinzhou circuit and deputy overall commander of the Tangut and Han forces of the Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, and Weisai armies, was made overall deployer of Tangut and Han cavalry and infantry on the northwest frontier, and removed from deputy overall command.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhang Jingda, former military governor of Jinzhou circuit and deputy overall commander of the northern border armies, was appointed overall deployer of Tangut and Han cavalry and infantry on the northwest frontier and relieved of his deputy command.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔：「諸州兩使判官、畿赤令有闕，取省郎、遺補、丞博、少列宮僚，選擇擢任。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict: "When there are vacancies for military administrators of the two commissioners in the circuits or magistrates of the capital districts, select and promote provincial gentlemen, remonstrance and supplement officials, assistant directors and academicians, and junior palace officials."
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict declared: "When vacancies arise for military administrators of the two commissioners in the circuits or for magistrates of the capital districts, select and promote from among provincial gentlemen, remonstrance and supplement officials, assistant directors and academicians, and junior palace officials."

sentences.zh: 」以忠正軍節度使、侍衛步軍都指揮使張彥琪為河陽節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Zhang Yanqi, military governor of the Zhongzheng army and commander of the Palace Guard infantry, was made military governor of Heyang circuit and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanqi, military governor of the Zhongzheng army and commander of the Palace Guard infantry, was appointed military governor of Heyang circuit and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry;

sentences.zh: 以彰聖都指揮使、饒州刺史符彥饒為忠正軍節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Fu Yanrao, commander of the Zhangsheng army and prefect of Raozhou, was made military governor of the Zhongzheng army and commander of the Palace Guard infantry.
translations.idiomatic: and Fu Yanrao, commander of the Zhangsheng army and prefect of Raozhou, was made military governor of the Zhongzheng army and commander of the Palace Guard infantry.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以雍王重美與汴州節度使範延光結婚，詔兗王從溫主之。

translations.literal: On bingshen, because Prince of Yong Chongmei was to marry the daughter of Bianzhou circuit military governor Fan Yanguang, an edict ordered Prince of Yan Congwen to preside.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, when Prince of Yong Chongmei was to marry into the family of Bianzhou military governor Fan Yanguang, an edict ordered Prince of Yan Congwen to preside over the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以國子祭酒馬縞卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On dingyou, because Director of the Imperial University Ma Gao died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou court was suspended upon the death of Director of the Imperial University Ma Gao.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，昭義奏，河東節度使石敬瑭叛。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Zhaoyi circuit memorialized that Hedong military governor Shi Jingtang had rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhaoyi circuit reported that Hedong military governor Shi Jingtang had rebelled.

sentences.zh: 以鴻臚卿兼通事舍人、判四方館王景崇為衛尉卿，充引進使。

translations.literal: Wang Jingchong, Director of the Court for Dependencies and concurrent Master of Ceremonies overseeing the Four Offices, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Regalia and commissioner of introductions.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingchong, Director of the Court for Dependencies and concurrent Master of Ceremonies overseeing the Four Offices, was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Regalia and commissioner of introductions.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，削奪石敬瑭官爵，便令張敬達進軍攻討。

translations.literal: On renyin, Shi Jingtang's titles and offices were stripped, and Zhang Jingda was immediately ordered to advance his army to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Shi Jingtang's titles and offices were stripped, and Zhang Jingda was immediately ordered to march his army against him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯。

translations.literal: On yimao.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao.

sentences.zh: 以晉州節度使張敬達為太原四面兵馬都部署，尋改為招討使；

translations.literal: Zhang Jingda, military governor of Jinzhou circuit, was made overall deployer of the armies on all four sides of Taiyuan, soon changed to pacification commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jingda, military governor of Jinzhou circuit, was appointed overall deployer of the armies surrounding Taiyuan, soon retitled pacification commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以河陽節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使張彥琪為太原四面馬步軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Zhang Yanqi, military governor of Heyang circuit and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry, was made overall commander of cavalry and infantry on all four sides of Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanqi, military governor of Heyang circuit and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry, was made overall commander of cavalry and infantry surrounding Taiyuan;

sentences.zh: 以邢州節度使安審琦為太原四面馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: An Shenqi, military governor of Xingzhou circuit, was made commander of cavalry on all four sides of Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi, military governor of Xingzhou circuit, was made commander of cavalry surrounding Taiyuan;

sentences.zh: 以陝州節度使相裏金為太原四面步軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Xiangli Jin, military governor of Shanzhou circuit, was made commander of infantry on all four sides of Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: Xiangli Jin, military governor of Shanzhou circuit, was made commander of infantry surrounding Taiyuan;

sentences.zh: 以右監門上將軍武廷翰為壕寨使。

translations.literal: Wu Tinghan, General-in-chief of the Right Gate Guards, was made commissioner of trenches and camps.
translations.idiomatic: and Wu Tinghan, General-in-chief of the Right Gate Guards, was made commissioner of trenches and camps.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以定州節度使楊光遠為太原四面兵馬副部署、兼馬步都虞候，尋改為太原四面副招討使，都虞候如故。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Dingzhou circuit, was made deputy overall deployer of the armies on all four sides of Taiyuan and concurrent chief military inspector of cavalry and infantry; soon changed to deputy pacification commissioner on all four sides of Taiyuan, with chief military inspector unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Dingzhou circuit, was appointed deputy overall deployer surrounding Taiyuan and chief military inspector of cavalry and infantry; he was soon retitled deputy pacification commissioner, retaining his post as chief military inspector.

sentences.zh: 以前彰武軍節度使高行周為太原四面招撫兼排陣使。

translations.literal: Former military governor of the Zhangwu army Gao Xingzhou was made pacification commissioner on all four sides of Taiyuan and commissioner of battle arrays.
translations.idiomatic: Former military governor of the Zhangwu army Gao Xingzhou was appointed pacification commissioner surrounding Taiyuan and commissioner of battle arrays.

sentences.zh: 初，帝疑河東有異志，與近臣語及其事，帝曰：「石郎與朕近親，在不疑之地，流言毀譽，朕心自明，萬一失歡，如何和解？

translations.literal: Earlier, the Emperor suspected that Hedong harbored disloyal intent. Speaking with close ministers about the matter, the Emperor said: "Shi Lang is my close kin, in the place of unquestioned trust. Slander and praise in rumor—my heart is clear on its own. If by chance we should fall out, how could we be reconciled?"
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Emperor had suspected that Hedong harbored disloyal intent. Speaking with close ministers about the matter, he said: "Shi Lang is my close kinsman, one in whom I ought to place unquestioning trust. Rumor may slander or praise him, but my own mind is clear. If by chance we should fall out, how could we ever be reconciled?"

sentences.zh: 」左右皆不對。

translations.literal: " Those at his side all made no reply.
translations.idiomatic: " Those around him made no reply.

sentences.zh: 翌日，欲移石敬瑭於鄆州，房暠等堅言不可，司天監趙延乂亦言星辰失度，尤宜安靜，由是稍緩其事。

translations.literal: The next day, he wished to transfer Shi Jingtang to Yanzhou; Fang Hao and others firmly said it could not be done; Director of the Astronomy Bureau Zhao Yanyi also said the stars were out of measure and that quiet was especially fitting; thereby the matter was somewhat delayed.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he wished to transfer Shi Jingtang to Yanzhou. Fang Hao and others firmly objected, and Director of the Astronomy Bureau Zhao Yanyi also said the stars were out of their proper courses and that quiet was especially advisable; thereby the matter was put off for a time.

sentences.zh: 會薛文遇獨宿於禁中，帝召之，諭以太原之事。

translations.literal: It happened that Xue Wenyü was lodging alone in the palace precincts; the Emperor summoned him and instructed him regarding the Taiyuan affair.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Xue Wenyü was lodging alone within the palace precincts. The Emperor summoned him and spoke to him about the Taiyuan affair.

sentences.zh: 文遇奏曰：「臣聞作舍於道，三年不成，國家利害，斷自宸旨以臣料之，石敬瑭除亦叛，不除亦叛，不如先事圖之。

translations.literal: Wenyü memorialized: "Your subject has heard that building a house in the road, three years do not complete it. The profit and harm of the state are decided by Your Majesty's intent. By your subject's estimate, whether Shi Jingtang is removed or not removed, he will rebel either way; better to take the initiative and plan against him first."
translations.idiomatic: Wenyü replied: "I have heard that building a house in the middle of the road takes three years and still is not finished. The welfare of the state rests on Your Majesty's decision. In my judgment, whether Shi Jingtang is removed or left in place, he will rebel either way. It would be better to strike first."

sentences.zh: 」帝喜曰：「聞卿此言，豁吾憤氣。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was pleased and said: "Hearing your words clears my pent-up anger."
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor was pleased and said: "Hearing you say this clears the anger pent up in my breast."

sentences.zh: 」先是，有人言國家明年合得一賢佐主謀，平定天下，帝意亦疑賢佐者屬在文遇，即令手書除目，子夜下學士院草制。

translations.literal: " Earlier, someone had said that next year the state would obtain a worthy assistant to take charge of planning and pacify the realm; the Emperor's mind also suspected that the worthy assistant meant Wenyü. He immediately ordered a handwritten appointment list and at midnight sent it down to the Academy to draft the edict.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier someone had said that the next year the state would gain a worthy counselor to direct strategy and pacify the realm. The Emperor also suspected that this worthy counselor was meant to be Wenyü. He immediately wrote out the appointment list himself and at midnight sent it to the Hanlin Academy to draft the edict.

sentences.zh: 翌日，宣製之際，兩班失色。

translations.literal: The next day, when the edict was proclaimed, both cohorts turned pale.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, when the edict was proclaimed, both civil and military cohorts turned pale.

sentences.zh: 居六七日，敬瑭上章云：「明宗社稷，陛下纂承，未契輿情，宜推令辟。

translations.literal: After six or seven days, Jingtang submitted a memorial saying: "The altars and hills of Emperor Mingzong—Your Majesty has succeeded to them, but they do not accord with public sentiment; you should yield to a worthy successor."
translations.idiomatic: Six or seven days later Jingtang submitted a memorial saying: "The realm of Emperor Mingzong—Your Majesty has succeeded to it, yet it does not accord with public sentiment. You ought to yield the throne to a worthy successor."

sentences.zh: 許王先朝血緒，養德皇闈，儻循當璧之言，免負鬩牆之議。

translations.literal: Prince of Xu is of the former dynasty's bloodline, reared in virtue within the imperial household; if you follow the words of one fit to hold the jade disk, you may avoid bearing the reproach of fraternal strife."
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xu is of the former dynasty's bloodline and was reared in virtue within the imperial household. If you heed the claim of one fit to hold the jade disk, you may avoid the reproach of fraternal strife."

sentences.zh: 」帝覽奏不悅，手攘抵地，召馬裔孫草詔報曰：「父有社稷，傳之於子；

translations.literal: " The Emperor, reading the memorial, was displeased; he struck the ground with his hand and summoned Ma Yisun to draft a reply edict saying: "A father has the altars and hills and passes them to his son;
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor, reading the memorial, was displeased. He struck the ground with his hand and summoned Ma Yisun to draft a reply edict: "A father holds the realm and passes it to his son;

sentences.zh: 君有禍難，倚之於親。

translations.literal: a lord has calamity and difficulty and relies on his kin.
translations.idiomatic: a lord in calamity relies on his kin.

sentences.zh: 卿於鄂王，故非疏遠。

translations.literal: You toward Prince of E are therefore not distant.
translations.idiomatic: As for you and Prince of E, you are hardly strangers.

sentences.zh: 往歲衛州之事，天下皆知；

translations.literal: Last year's affair at Weizhou—all under Heaven know it;
translations.idiomatic: Last year's affair at Weizhou is known to all under Heaven;

sentences.zh: 今朝許王之言，人誰肯信！

translations.literal: today's words of Prince of Xu—who would believe them!
translations.idiomatic: who today would believe the words of Prince of Xu!

sentences.zh: 英賢立事，安肯如斯」云。

translations.literal: Would a worthy hero undertaking great affairs be willing to act like this?" and so on.
translations.idiomatic: Would a worthy hero undertaking great affairs ever stoop to such conduct?" and so forth.

sentences.zh: 戊申，張敬達奏，西北面先鋒都指揮使安審信率雄義左第二指揮二百二十七騎，並部下共五百騎，剽劫百井，叛入太原。

translations.literal: On wushen, Zhang Jingda memorialized that An Shenxin, commander of the northwest frontier vanguard, led two hundred twenty-seven horsemen of the Left Second Command of the Xiongyi army and five hundred horsemen including his subordinates in all, raided Baijing, and defected into Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhang Jingda reported that An Shenxin, commander of the northwest frontier vanguard, had led two hundred twenty-seven horsemen of the Left Second Command of the Xiongyi army, together with five hundred horsemen counting his subordinates, raided Baijing, and defected to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 又奏，大軍已至太原城下。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that the great army had already reached below the walls of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that the main army had already reached the walls of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 詔安審信及雄義兵士妻男並處斬，家產沒官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the wives and children of An Shenxin and the Xiongyi soldiers all be executed and their household property confiscated by the state.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that the wives and children of An Shenxin and the Xiongyi soldiers all be executed and their household property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 先是，雄義都在伏州屯戍，其指揮使安元信謀殺伏州刺史張朗，事泄，戍兵自潰，奔安審信軍，審信與之入太原。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Xiongyi army was garrisoned at Fuzhou; its commander An Yuanxin plotted to kill Fuzhou prefect Zhang Lang; the affair leaked; the garrison troops broke on their own, fled to An Shenxin's army, and Shenxin entered Taiyuan with them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Xiongyi army had been garrisoned at Fuzhou. Its commander An Yuanxin had plotted to kill Fuzhou prefect Zhang Lang; when the plot was exposed the garrison troops broke ranks on their own, fled to An Shenxin's army, and Shenxin entered Taiyuan with them.

sentences.zh: 太常奏，於河南府東權立宣憲太后寢宮，從之。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized that a provisional sleeping palace for Empress Dowager Xuanxian be established east of Henan prefecture; approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices proposed establishing a provisional sleeping palace for Empress Dowager Xuanxian east of Henan prefecture; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 己酉，振武節度使安叔千奏，西北界巡檢使安重榮驅掠戍兵五百騎叛入太原。

translations.literal: On jiyou, An Shuqian, military governor of the Zhenwu army, memorialized that An Chongrong, frontier inspector of the northwest border, drove off five hundred garrison horsemen and defected into Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou An Shuqian, military governor of the Zhenwu army, reported that An Chongrong, frontier inspector of the northwest border, had driven off five hundred garrison horsemen and defected to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 以新授河東節度使宋審虔為宣州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Song Shenqian, newly appointed military governor of Hedong circuit, was made military governor of Xuanzhou circuit and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shenqian, newly appointed military governor of Hedong circuit, was made military governor of Xuanzhou circuit and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry.

sentences.zh: 壬子，鄴都屯駐捧聖都虞候張令昭逐節度使劉延皓，據城叛。

translations.literal: On renzi, Zhang Lingzhao, chief military inspector of the Pingsheng army garrisoned at Yedu, expelled military governor Liu Yanhao and seized the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Zhang Lingzhao, chief military inspector of the Pingsheng army garrisoned at Yedu, expelled military governor Liu Yanhao and seized the city in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 翌日，令昭召副使邊仁嗣已下逼令奏請節旄。

translations.literal: The next day, Lingzhao summoned the deputy commissioner Bian Rensi and those below and compelled them to memorialize requesting the command baton.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Lingzhao summoned deputy commissioner Bian Rensi and the others and compelled them to memorialize requesting the command baton for him.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，天雄軍節度使劉延皓削奪官爵，勒歸私第。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinyou: Liu Yanhao, military governor of the Tianxiong army, had his titles and offices stripped and was compelled to return to his private residence.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the sixth month Liu Yanhao, military governor of the Tianxiong army, had his titles and offices stripped and was compelled to return to private life.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以天雄軍守禦、右捧聖第二軍都虞候張令昭為檢校司空，行右千牛將軍，權知天雄軍府事。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhang Lingzhao, defender of the Tianxiong army and chief military inspector of the Right Second Army of the Pingsheng army, was given the additional title of Honorary Minister of Works, acting General of the Right Palace Guard, and provisional administrator of the Tianxiong army headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Lingzhao, defender of the Tianxiong army and chief military inspector of the Right Second Army of the Pingsheng army, was given the additional title of Honorary Minister of Works, acting General of the Right Palace Guard, and provisional administrator of the Tianxiong army headquarters.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，禦敷政殿，遣工部尚書崔居儉奉宣憲皇太后寶冊於寢宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he presided in the Hall of Broad Governance and dispatched Minister of Works Cui Jujian to present the precious register of Empress Dowager Xuanxian at the sleeping palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Emperor took the Hall of Broad Governance and dispatched Minister of Works Cui Jujian to present the precious register of Empress Dowager Xuanxian at the sleeping palace.

sentences.zh: 時陵園在河東，適會兵興，故權於京城修奉寢宮上諡焉。

translations.literal: At that time the mausoleum was in Hedong; it happened to coincide with the rising of armies, so provisionally in the capital they maintained the sleeping palace and bestowed the posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the mausoleum lay in Hedong, and war had just broken out; therefore a sleeping palace was provisionally maintained in the capital and her posthumous title was bestowed there.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以西上閣門副使、少府監兼通事舍人劉頎為鴻臚卿，職如故。

translations.literal: On jisi, Liu Qi, deputy commissioner of the Western Upper Gate Office, Director of the Palace Workshops, and concurrent Master of Ceremonies, was made Director of the Court for Dependencies, with duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Liu Qi, deputy commissioner of the Western Upper Gate Office, Director of the Palace Workshops, and concurrent Master of Ceremonies, was appointed Director of the Court for Dependencies, retaining his other duties.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔曰：「時雨稍愆，頗傷農稼，分命朝臣祈禱。

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict said: "The seasonal rains are somewhat delayed, greatly harming the crops; court officials are separately ordered to pray."
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict declared: "The seasonal rains are somewhat delayed and the crops have suffered greatly. Court officials are hereby dispatched to offer prayers."

sentences.zh: 」辛未，工部尚書致仕許寂卒。

translations.literal: " On xinwei, Xu Ji, retired Minister of Works, died.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinwei Xu Ji, retired Minister of Works, died.

sentences.zh: 以權知魏府事、右千牛將軍張令昭為齊州防禦使，以捧聖右第三指揮使邢立為德州刺史，以捧聖第五指揮使康福進為鄚州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhang Lingzhao, provisional administrator of the Wei prefecture headquarters and acting General of the Right Palace Guard, was made Defender of Qizhou; Xing Li, commander of the Right Third Command of the Pingsheng army, was made prefect of Dezhou; Kang Fujin, commander of the Fifth Command of the Pingsheng army, was made prefect of Mozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Lingzhao, provisional administrator of the Wei prefecture headquarters and acting General of the Right Palace Guard, was appointed Defender of Qizhou; Xing Li, commander of the Right Third Command of the Pingsheng army, was made prefect of Dezhou; and Kang Fujin, commander of the Fifth Command of the Pingsheng army, was made prefect of Mozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以汴州節度使範延光為天雄軍四面招討使，知行府事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Fan Yanguang, military governor of Bianzhou circuit, was made pacification commissioner on all four sides of the Tianxiong army and administered the headquarters in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Fan Yanguang, military governor of Bianzhou circuit, was appointed pacification commissioner on all four sides of the Tianxiong army and personally administered the headquarters.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以西京留守李周為天雄軍四面副招討使兼兵馬都監。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Li Zhou, Western Capital regent, was made deputy pacification commissioner on all four sides of the Tianxiong army and overall military inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Zhou, Western Capital regent, was appointed deputy pacification commissioner on all four sides of the Tianxiong army and overall military inspector.

sentences.zh: 詔河東將佐節度判官趙瑩以下十四人並籍沒家產。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Zhao Ying, military administrator of Hedong circuit, and fourteen subordinates below him all have their household property registered and confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Zhao Ying, military administrator of Hedong circuit, and fourteen of his subordinates below him all have their household property registered and confiscated.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，範延光奏，領軍至鄴都攻城。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuzi: Fan Yanguang memorialized that he had led his army to Yedu and was attacking the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the seventh month of autumn Fan Yanguang reported that he had led his army to Yedu and was besieging the city.

sentences.zh: 己丑，誅右衛上將軍石重英、皇城副使石重裔，皆敬瑭之子也。

translations.literal: On jichou, Shi Chongying, General-in-chief of the Right Guard, and Shi Chongyi, deputy commissioner of the Imperial City, were executed; both were sons of Jingtang.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Shi Chongying, General-in-chief of the Right Guard, and Shi Chongyi, deputy commissioner of the Imperial City, were executed; both were sons of Jingtang.

sentences.zh: 時重英等匿於民家井中，獲而誅之，並族所匿之家。

translations.literal: At the time Chongying and the others were hiding in a commoner's well; they were seized and executed, and the households that had hidden them were exterminated to the clan.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chongying and the others were hiding in a commoner's well. They were seized and executed, and the households that had hidden them were exterminated to the clan.

sentences.zh: 奚首領達剌幹遣通事介老奏，奚王李素姑謀叛入契丹，已處斬訖，達剌幹權知本部落事。

translations.literal: The Xi chieftain Dalagan sent the interpreter Jielao to memorialize that the Xi king Li Sugu had plotted to defect to the Khitan and had already been executed; Dalagan was provisionally placed in charge of the tribe's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi chieftain Dalagan sent the interpreter Jielao to report that the Xi king Li Sugu had plotted to defect to the Khitan and had already been executed; Dalagan was provisionally placed in charge of tribal affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，沂州奏，誅都指揮使石敬德，並族其家，敬瑭之弟也。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Yizhou memorialized that the commander Shi Jingde was executed and his household exterminated to the clan; he was Jingtang's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Yizhou reported that commander Shi Jingde had been executed and his household exterminated to the clan; he was Jingtang's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以前彰武軍節度使高行周為潞州節度使，充太原四面招撫排陣使；

translations.literal: On yiwei, former military governor of the Zhangwu army Gao Xingzhou was made military governor of Luzhou circuit and pacification commissioner and commissioner of battle arrays on all four sides of Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei former military governor of the Zhangwu army Gao Xingzhou was appointed military governor of Luzhou circuit and pacification commissioner and commissioner of battle arrays surrounding Taiyuan;

sentences.zh: 以潞州節度使皇甫立為華州節度使。

translations.literal: Huangfu Li, military governor of Luzhou circuit, was made military governor of Huazhou circuit.
translations.idiomatic: and Huangfu Li, military governor of Luzhou circuit, was made military governor of Huazhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，雲州節度使沙彥珣奏，此月二日夜，步軍指揮使桑遷作亂，以兵圍子城，彥珣突圍出城，就西山據雷公口。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Sha Yanxun, military governor of Yunzhou circuit, memorialized that on the night of the second day of this month, the infantry commander Sang Qian rebelled, surrounded the inner city with troops, Yanxun broke out and left the city, and took position at Leigong Pass on the western hills.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Sha Yanxun, military governor of Yunzhou circuit, reported that on the night of the second day of that month the infantry commander Sang Qian had rebelled, surrounded the inner city with troops, and that Yanxun had broken out of the city and taken position at Leigong Pass on the western hills.

sentences.zh: 三日，招集兵士入城誅亂軍，軍城如故。

translations.literal: On the third day, he gathered troops, entered the city, executed the rebel army, and the military city was as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day he gathered troops, entered the city, executed the rebel soldiers, and the military city was restored as before.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以將作監丞、介國公宇文頡為汝州襄城令。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Yuwen Qi, Assistant Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings and Duke of Jie, was made magistrate of Xiangcheng in Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yuwen Qi, Assistant Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings and Duke of Jie, was appointed magistrate of Xiangcheng in Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以衛尉卿聶延祚為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On yisi, Nie Yanzuo, Director of the Court of Imperial Regalia, was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Nie Yanzuo, Director of the Court of Imperial Regalia, was appointed Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 戊申，範延光奏，此月二十一日收復鄴都，群臣稱賀。

translations.literal: On wushen, Fan Yanguang memorialized that on the twenty-first day of this month Yedu was recovered; the ministers offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Fan Yanguang reported that Yedu had been recovered on the twenty-first day of that month, and the ministers offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以禮部侍郎張昭遠為御史中丞；

translations.literal: On jiyou, Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Censor-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Rites, was appointed Censor-in-chief;

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞呂琦為禮部侍郎，充端明殿學士。

translations.literal: Lü Qi, Censor-in-chief, was made Vice Minister of Rites and academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness.
translations.idiomatic: and Lü Qi, Censor-in-chief, was made Vice Minister of Rites and academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，中書奏：「劉延皓賓佐等，帥臣既已削奪，其行軍司馬李延筠、副使邊仁嗣以下，望命放歸田里。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Secretariat memorialized: "Liu Yanhao's staff and assistants: since the commander has already been stripped of office, his campaign marshal Li Yanjun, deputy commissioner Bian Rensi, and those below—we hope they may be ordered released to their home districts."
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Secretariat reported: "Since commander Liu Yanhao has already been stripped of office, we ask that his campaign marshal Li Yanjun, deputy commissioner Bian Rensi, and those below them be released to return to their home districts."

sentences.zh: 」奏入，帝大怒，詔大理曰：「帥臣失守，已行削奪，其僚佐合當何罪？

translations.literal: " When the memorial entered, the Emperor was greatly angered and ordered the Court of Judicial Review: "The commander lost his post and has already been stripped; what crime do his assistants merit?"
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial arrived, the Emperor was furious and ordered the Court of Judicial Review: "The commander lost his post and has already been stripped. What punishment do his assistants deserve?"

sentences.zh: 」既而竟依中書所奏。

translations.literal: " In the end they still followed what the Secretariat had memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end the court still followed the Secretariat's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔範延光誅張令昭部下五指揮及忠銳、忠肅兩指揮。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict ordered Fan Yanguang to execute the five commands under Zhang Lingzhao and the two commands Zhongrui and Zhongsu.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict ordered Fan Yanguang to execute the five commands under Zhang Lingzhao and the two commands Zhongrui and Zhongsu.

sentences.zh: 繼範延光奏，追兵遣襲張令昭部下敗兵至邢州沙河，斬首三百級，並獻張令昭、邢立、李貴等首級。

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang then memorialized that pursuing troops were sent to attack Zhang Lingzhao's defeated soldiers as far as Shahe in Xingzhou, beheading three hundred; the heads of Zhang Lingzhao, Xing Li, Li Gui, and others were also presented.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang then reported that pursuing troops had attacked Zhang Lingzhao's defeated soldiers as far as Shahe in Xingzhou, taking three hundred heads, and that the heads of Zhang Lingzhao, Xing Li, Li Gui, and others had been presented.

sentences.zh: 又奏，獲張令昭同惡捧聖指揮使米全以下諸指揮使都頭凡十三人，並磔於府門。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that Mi Quan, Pingsheng army commander, and the commanders-in-chief of the commands, thirteen men in all who shared Zhang Lingzhao's guilt, were captured and dismembered at the prefectural gate.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that Mi Quan, Pingsheng army commander, and twelve other commanders-in-chief who had shared Zhang Lingzhao's guilt were captured and dismembered at the prefectural gate.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，左衛上將軍仇暉卒。

translations.literal: On guichou, Qiu Hui, General-in-chief of the Left Guard, died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Qiu Hui, General-in-chief of the Left Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 洺州奏擒獲魏府作亂捧聖指揮使馬彥柔以下五十八人。

translations.literal: Luozhou memorialized that Ma Yanrou, Pingsheng army commander who rebelled at the Wei prefecture headquarters, and fifty-eight men below him were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Luozhou reported that Ma Yanrou, Pingsheng army commander who had rebelled at the Wei prefecture headquarters, and fifty-eight men below him had been captured.

sentences.zh: 邢、磁州相次擒獲亂兵，並送京師。

translations.literal: Xingzhou and Cizhou in succession captured rebel troops and all sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhou and Cizhou in succession captured rebel troops and sent them all to the capital.

sentences.zh: 彰聖指揮使張萬迪以部下五百騎叛入太原，詔誅家屬於懷州本營。

translations.literal: Zhang Wandi, Zhangsheng army commander, defected into Taiyuan with five hundred horsemen of his command; an edict ordered his family executed at their home camp in Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wandi, Zhangsheng army commander, defected to Taiyuan with five hundred horsemen of his command. An edict ordered his family executed at their home camp in Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，契丹遣使摩哩入朝。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuwu: the Khitan sent the envoy Moli to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the eighth month the Khitan sent the envoy Moli to court.

sentences.zh: 己未，以汴州節度使範延光為天雄軍節度使、守太傅、兼中書令；

translations.literal: On jiwei, Fan Yanguang, military governor of Bianzhou circuit, was made military governor of the Tianxiong army, Guardian Grand Mentor, and concurrent Grand Secretary;
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Fan Yanguang, military governor of Bianzhou circuit, was appointed military governor of the Tianxiong army, Guardian Grand Mentor, and concurrent Grand Secretary;

sentences.zh: 以西京留守李周為汴州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事。

translations.literal: Li Zhou, Western Capital regent, was made military governor of Bianzhou circuit, Honorary Grand General, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: and Li Zhou, Western Capital regent, was made military governor of Bianzhou circuit, Honorary Grand General, and Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，應州奏，契丹三千騎迫城。

translations.literal: On guihai, Yingzhou memorialized that three thousand Khitan horsemen were pressing the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Yingzhou reported that three thousand Khitan horsemen were pressing the city.

sentences.zh: 詔端明殿學士呂琦往河東忻、代諸屯戍所犒軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Lü Qi, academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness, to go to the garrisons at Xin, Dai, and other stations in Hedong to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Lü Qi, academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness, to go to the garrisons at Xin, Dai, and other stations in Hedong to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 以左龍武大將軍袁義為右監門上將軍，以振武軍節度使安叔千充代北兵馬都部署。

translations.literal: Yuan Yi, Grand General of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was made General-in-chief of the Right Gate Guards; An Shuqian, military governor of the Zhenwu army, was made overall deployer of troops north of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Yi, Grand General of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was made General-in-chief of the Right Gate Guards, and An Shuqian, military governor of the Zhenwu army, was appointed overall deployer of troops north of Dai.

sentences.zh: 己巳，雲州沙彥珣奏，供奉官李讓勳送夏衣到州，縱酒淩轢軍都行，劫殺兵馬都監張思殷、都指揮使黨行進，其李讓勳已處斬訖。

translations.literal: On jisi, Sha Yanxun of Yunzhou memorialized that the palace attendant Li Rangxun, delivering summer clothing to the prefecture, got drunk and bullied the army on the march, robbed and killed the overall military inspector Zhang Siyin and the commander Dang Xingjin; Li Rangxun had already been executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Sha Yanxun of Yunzhou reported that the palace attendant Li Rangxun, while delivering summer clothing to the prefecture, got drunk and bullied the army on the march, then robbed and killed overall military inspector Zhang Siyin and commander Dang Xingjin; Li Rangxun had already been executed.

sentences.zh: 張敬達奏，造五龍橋攻太原城次。

translations.literal: Zhang Jingda memorialized that he was building the Five Dragons Bridge to attack the walls of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jingda reported that he was building the Five Dragons Bridge to attack the walls of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以鎮州節度使董溫琪充東北面副招討使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Dong Wenqi, military governor of Zhenzhou circuit, was made deputy pacification commissioner of the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Dong Wenqi, military governor of Zhenzhou circuit, was appointed deputy pacification commissioner of the northeast.

sentences.zh: 己卯，洺州獻野繭二十斤。

translations.literal: On jimao, Luozhou presented twenty jin of wild cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Luozhou presented twenty jin of wild cocoons.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，張敬達奏，賊城內出騎軍三十隊、步卒三千人衝長連城，高行周襲殺入壕，溺死者大半，擒賊將安小喜以下百餘人，甲馬一百八十匹。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Zhang Jingda memorialized that from within the rebel city thirty cavalry units and three thousand infantry charged the long linked camps; Gao Xingzhou attacked and killed them as they entered the moat; more than half drowned; over a hundred rebel generals including An Xiaoxi were captured, with one hundred eighty suits of armor and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Zhang Jingda reported that from within the rebel city thirty cavalry units and three thousand infantry had charged the long linked camps. Gao Xingzhou attacked them as they entered the moat; more than half drowned. Over a hundred rebel generals including An Xiaoxi were captured, along with one hundred eighty suits of armor and horses.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，張敬達奏，此月十五日，與契丹戰於太原城下，王師敗績。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiachen: Zhang Jingda memorialized that on the fifteenth day of this month he fought the Khitan below the walls of Taiyuan and the imperial army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the ninth month Zhang Jingda reported that on the fifteenth day of that month he had fought the Khitan below the walls of Taiyuan and the imperial army had been defeated.

sentences.zh: 時契丹主自率部族來援太原，高行周、符彥卿率左右廂騎軍出鬥，蕃軍引退。

translations.literal: At the time the Khitan ruler personally led his tribes to relieve Taiyuan; Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing led the left and right wing cavalry out to fight, and the barbarian army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Khitan ruler personally led his tribes to relieve Taiyuan. Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing led the left and right wing cavalry out to fight, and the barbarian army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 巳時後，蕃軍復成列，張敬達、楊光遠、安審琦等陣於賊城西北，倚山橫陣，諸將奮擊，蕃軍屢卻。

translations.literal: After the si hour, the barbarian army re-formed its ranks; Zhang Jingda, Yang Guangyuan, An Shenqi, and others arrayed northwest of the rebel city, leaning on the mountains in a horizontal formation; the generals fought fiercely and the barbarian army repeatedly fell back.
translations.idiomatic: After the si hour the barbarian army re-formed its ranks. Zhang Jingda, Yang Guangyuan, An Shenqi, and others arrayed northwest of the rebel city in a line along the mountains. The generals fought fiercely and the barbarian army repeatedly fell back.

sentences.zh: 至晡，我騎軍將移陣，蕃軍如山而進，王師大敗，投兵仗相藉而死者山積。

translations.literal: By the hour of shen, our cavalry was about to shift formation when the barbarian army advanced like a mountain; the imperial army was greatly defeated; those who cast aside weapons and lay piled upon one another in death heaped up like hills.
translations.idiomatic: By late afternoon our cavalry was about to shift formation when the barbarian army advanced like a mountain. The imperial army was routed; men who cast aside their weapons lay piled upon one another in death, heaped like hills.

sentences.zh: 是夕，收合餘眾，保於晉祠南晉安寨，蕃軍塹而圍之，自是音聞阻絕。

translations.literal: That evening they gathered the remaining troops and held Jin'an camp south of Jinci; the barbarian army trenched and besieged them; from then on communications were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: That evening they gathered the survivors and held Jin'an camp south of Jinci. The barbarian army dug trenches and besieged them; from then on all communications were cut off.

sentences.zh: 朝廷大恐。

translations.literal: The court was greatly terrified.
translations.idiomatic: The court was seized with terror.

sentences.zh: 是日，遣侍衛步軍都指揮使符彥饒率兵屯河陽，詔範延光率兵由青山路趨榆次，詔幽州趙德鈞由飛狐路出敵軍後，輝州防禦使潘環合防戍軍出慈、隰以援張敬達。

translations.literal: That day, Fu Yanrao, commander of the Palace Guard infantry, was dispatched to station troops at Heyang; Fan Yanguang was ordered to lead troops by the Qingshan route toward Yuci; Zhao Dejun of Youzhou was ordered to come out behind the enemy by the Flying Fox route; Pan Huan, Defender of Huizhou, was to combine frontier garrison troops and advance from Ci and Xi to relieve Zhang Jingda.
translations.idiomatic: That day Fu Yanrao, commander of the Palace Guard infantry, was dispatched to station troops at Heyang. Fan Yanguang was ordered to lead troops by the Qingshan route toward Yuci; Zhao Dejun of Youzhou was to come out behind the enemy by the Flying Fox route; and Pan Huan, Defender of Huizhou, was to combine frontier garrison troops and advance from Ci and Xi to relieve Zhang Jingda.

sentences.zh: 以前絳州刺史韓彥惲為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Han Yanyun, former prefect of Jiangzhou, was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yanyun, former prefect of Jiangzhou, was appointed Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 契丹主移帳於柳林。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler moved his camp to Willow Grove.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler moved his camp to Willow Grove.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔取二十二日幸北面軍前。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict set the twenty-second day for the Emperor to visit the northern frontier army.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict set the twenty-second day for the Emperor to visit the northern frontier army.

sentences.zh: 戊申，帝發京師，路經徽陵，帝親行謁奠。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Emperor departed the capital; passing Hui Mausoleum, the Emperor personally went to offer libation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Emperor departed the capital. Passing Hui Mausoleum, he personally went to offer libation.

sentences.zh: 夕次河陽，召群臣議進取，盧文紀勸帝駐河橋。

translations.literal: In the evening he halted at Heyang, summoned the ministers to discuss advance, and Lu Wenji urged the Emperor to remain at He Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: That evening he halted at Heyang, summoned the ministers to discuss strategy, and Lu Wenji urged the Emperor to remain at He Bridge.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，樞密使趙延壽先赴潞州。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Yanshou, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, went ahead to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhao Yanshou, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, went ahead to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸懷州。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he visited Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he visited Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 召吏部侍郎龍敏訪以機事，敏勸帝立東丹王讚華為契丹主，以兵援送入蕃，則契丹主有後顧之患，不能久駐漢地矣。

translations.literal: He summoned Long Min, Vice Minister of Personnel, to consult on urgent affairs; Min urged the Emperor to install the Prince of Eastern Dan, Zanhua, as Khitan ruler, send troops to escort him into the barbarian lands, and then the Khitan ruler would have worries behind him and could not long remain in Han territory.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned Long Min, Vice Minister of Personnel, to consult on urgent affairs. Min urged the Emperor to install the Prince of Eastern Dan, Zanhua, as Khitan ruler and send troops to escort him into the barbarian lands; then the Khitan ruler would have worries behind him and could not long remain in Han territory.

sentences.zh: 帝深以為然，竟不行其謀。

translations.literal: The Emperor deeply agreed, but in the end did not carry out the plan.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor deeply agreed, but in the end did not carry out the plan.

sentences.zh: （《遼史·義宗傳》云：「倍雖在異國，常思其親，問安之使不絕。

translations.literal: (The 《History of Liao, Biography of the Righteous Ancestor》 says: "Bei, though in a foreign land, constantly thought of his kin; envoys bearing inquiries after their welfare never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《History of Liao, Biography of the Righteous Ancestor》 says: "Bei, though in a foreign land, constantly thought of his kin; envoys bearing inquiries after their welfare never ceased.

sentences.zh: 後明宗養子從珂弑其君自立，倍密報太宗曰：「從珂弑君，盍討之！

translations.literal: Later Emperor Mingzong's adopted son Congke murdered his lord and established himself; Bei secretly reported to Emperor Taizong: "Congke murdered his lord—why not punish him!"
translations.idiomatic: Later Emperor Mingzong's adopted son Congke murdered his lord and established himself. Bei secretly reported to Emperor Taizong: "Congke murdered his lord. Why not punish him!"

sentences.zh: 」是東丹王實啟兵端，唐君臣或知其陰謀，故龍敏之說不行。）〉

translations.literal: " Thus the Prince of Eastern Dan in fact opened hostilities; the Tang ruler and ministers may have known his secret plot; hence Long Min's proposal was not carried out.)]
translations.idiomatic: " Thus the Prince of Eastern Dan had in fact opened hostilities; the Tang ruler and ministers may have known his secret plot; hence Long Min's proposal was not carried out.)]

sentences.zh: 帝自是酣飲悲歌，形神慘沮。

translations.literal: From then on the Emperor drank heavily and sang mournfully; his form and spirit were wretched and dejected.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the Emperor drank heavily and sang mournful songs; his body and spirit were wretched and dejected.

sentences.zh: 臣下勸其親征，則曰：「卿輩勿說石郎，使我心膽墮地！

translations.literal: When his ministers urged him to take the field in person, he said: "Do not speak to me of Shi Lang—it makes my heart and gall drop to the ground!"
translations.idiomatic: When his ministers urged him to take the field in person, he said: "Do not speak to me of Shi Lang. It makes my heart drop into my boots!"

sentences.zh: 」其怯憊也如此。

translations.literal: " Such was his timidity and exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was his timidity and exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳夜，彗星出虛危，長尺餘。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, night of dingsi: a comet appeared in Xu and Wei, more than a foot long.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingsi in the tenth month of winter a comet appeared in Xu and Wei, more than a foot long.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔天下括馬，又詔民十戶出兵一人，器甲自備。

translations.literal: On renxu, an edict ordered horses requisitioned throughout the realm; another edict ordered one soldier from every ten households, with weapons and armor self-provided.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict ordered horses requisitioned throughout the realm. Another edict ordered one soldier from every ten households, with weapons and armor to be provided by themselves.

sentences.zh: （《契丹國志》：唐發民為兵，每七戶出征夫一人，自備鎧仗，謂之「義軍」，凡得馬二千餘匹，征夫五千人，民間大擾。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Chronicle of the Khitan State》: Tang conscripted the people as soldiers; for every seven households one conscript was taken, providing his own armor and weapons; they were called the "Righteous Army"; in all more than two thousand horses and five thousand conscripts were obtained; the populace was greatly disturbed.)]
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Chronicle of the Khitan State》 records that Tang conscripted the people as soldiers: for every seven households one conscript was taken, providing his own armor and weapons. They were called the "Righteous Army." In all more than two thousand horses and five thousand conscripts were obtained, and the populace was greatly disturbed.)]

sentences.zh: 戊辰，代州刺史張朗超授檢校太保，以其屢殺敵眾，故以是命獎之。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Zhang Lang of Daizhou was given the additional title of Honorary Grand Guardian, because he had repeatedly killed many of the enemy; hence this order to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhang Lang of Daizhou was given the additional title of Honorary Grand Guardian because he had repeatedly killed many of the enemy; hence this order to reward him.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幽州趙德鈞以本軍三千騎與鎮州董溫琪由吳兒穀趨潞州。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Zhao Dejun of Youzhou led three thousand horsemen of his own army with Dong Wenqi of Zhenzhou by the Wuer Valley route toward Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zhao Dejun of Youzhou led three thousand horsemen of his own army with Dong Wenqi of Zhenzhou by the Wuer Valley route toward Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，以趙德鈞為諸道行營都統，以趙延壽為河東道南面行營招討使，以劉延朗副之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuzi: Zhao Dejun was made overall commander of the expeditionary forces of all circuits; Zhao Yanshou was made pacification commissioner of the southern Hedong circuit expeditionary camp, with Liu Yanlang as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the eleventh month Zhao Dejun was appointed overall commander of the expeditionary forces of all circuits; Zhao Yanshou was made pacification commissioner of the southern Hedong circuit expeditionary camp, with Liu Yanlang as deputy.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以範延光為河東道東南面行營招討使，以李周副之。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Fan Yanguang was made pacification commissioner of the southeastern Hedong circuit expeditionary camp, with Li Zhou as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Fan Yanguang was appointed pacification commissioner of the southeastern Hedong circuit expeditionary camp, with Li Zhou as deputy.

sentences.zh: 帝以呂琦嘗佐幽州幕，乃命齎都統官告以賜德鈞，兼犒軍士。

translations.literal: Because Lü Qi had once served on the Youzhou staff, the Emperor ordered him to carry the overall commander's commission and bestow it on Dejun, and also to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Because Lü Qi had once served on the Youzhou staff, the Emperor ordered him to carry the overall commander's commission and bestow it on Dejun, and also to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 琦至，從容宣帝委任之意，德鈞曰：「既以兵相委，焉敢惜死！

translations.literal: When Qi arrived, he calmly conveyed the Emperor's intent to entrust him; Dejun said: "Since troops have been entrusted to me, how would I dare spare my life!"
translations.idiomatic: When Qi arrived, he calmly conveyed the Emperor's intent to entrust him. Dejun said: "Since troops have been entrusted to me, how could I dare spare my life!"

sentences.zh: 」德鈞志在並範延光軍，奏請與延光會合。

translations.literal: " Dejun's aim was to absorb Fan Yanguang's army; he memorialized requesting to join forces with Yanguang.
translations.idiomatic: " Dejun's aim was to absorb Fan Yanguang's army. He memorialized requesting to join forces with Yanguang.

sentences.zh: 帝以詔諭延光，延光不從。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent an edict instructing Yanguang; Yanguang did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent an edict instructing Yanguang, but Yanguang did not comply.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，延州上言，節度使楊漢章為部眾所殺，以前坊州刺史劉景嚴為延州留後。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Yanzhou reported that military governor Yang Hanzhang was killed by his troops; Liu Jingyan, former prefect of Fangzhou, was made acting commissioner of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Yanzhou reported that military governor Yang Hanzhang had been killed by his troops. Liu Jingyan, former prefect of Fangzhou, was made acting commissioner of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，趙德鈞奏，大軍至團柏穀，前鋒殺蕃軍五百騎。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Zhao Dejun memorialized that the great army reached Tuanbai Valley and the vanguard killed five hundred barbarian horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhao Dejun reported that the main army had reached Tuanbai Valley and the vanguard had killed five hundred barbarian horsemen.

sentences.zh: 範延光奏，軍至榆次，蕃軍退入河東川界。

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang memorialized that the army reached Yuci and the barbarian army withdrew into the Hedong riverlands.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang reported that the army had reached Yuci and the barbarian army had withdrawn into the Hedong riverlands.

sentences.zh: 潘環奏，隰州逐退蕃軍。

translations.literal: Pan Huan memorialized that Xizhou had driven back the barbarian army.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Huan reported that Xizhou had driven back the barbarian army.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，趙德鈞奏，軍出穀口，蕃軍漸退，契丹主見駐柳林寨。

translations.literal: On renyin, Zhao Dejun memorialized that the army left the valley mouth, the barbarian army gradually withdrew, and the Khitan ruler was seen stationed at Willow Grove camp.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhao Dejun reported that the army had left the valley mouth, the barbarian army was gradually withdrawing, and the Khitan ruler was seen stationed at Willow Grove camp.

sentences.zh: 時德鈞累奏乞授延壽鎮州節制，帝怒曰：「德鈞父子堅要鎮州，苟能逐退蕃戎，要代予位，亦甘心矣。

translations.literal: At the time Dejun repeatedly memorialized requesting that Yanshou be granted control of Zhenzhou; the Emperor angrily said: "Dejun father and son insist on Zhenzhou; if they can drive back the barbarians, even if they want to take my place, I would be content."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Dejun repeatedly memorialized requesting that Yanshou be granted control of Zhenzhou. The Emperor said angrily: "Dejun father and son insist on Zhenzhou. If they can drive back the barbarians, even if they want to take my throne, I would be content."

sentences.zh: 若玩寇要君，但恐犬兔俱斃。

translations.literal: But if they toy with the enemy and coerce their lord, I fear dog and hare will both perish."
translations.idiomatic: But if they toy with the enemy and coerce their lord, I fear we shall all perish together."

sentences.zh: 」德鈞聞之不悅。

translations.literal: " Dejun, hearing this, was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: " Dejun, hearing this, was displeased.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙辰，日南至，群臣稱賀於行宮，帝曰：「晉安寨內將士，應思家國矣。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, bingchen: at the winter solstice the ministers offered congratulations at the traveling palace; the Emperor said: "The officers and soldiers within Jin'an camp must be thinking of home and state."
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the intercalary month, at the winter solstice the ministers offered congratulations at the traveling palace. The Emperor said: "The officers and soldiers within Jin'an camp must be thinking of home and state."

sentences.zh: 」因泣下久之。

translations.literal: " He then wept for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: " He then wept for a long time.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以岢嵐軍為勝州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Kelan army was made Shengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Kelan army was made Shengzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以右龍武統軍李從昶為左龍武統軍，以前邠州節度使楊思權為右龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Li Congchang, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army; Yang Siquan, former military governor of Binzhou circuit, was made commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Li Congchang, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, and Yang Siquan, former military governor of Binzhou circuit, was made commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，丹州刺史康承詢停任，配流鄧州。

translations.literal: On renxu, Kang Chengxun, prefect of Danzhou, was removed from office and exiled to Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Kang Chengxun, prefect of Danzhou, was removed from office and exiled to Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 時承詢奉詔率義軍赴延州義軍亂，承詢奔鄜州，故有是責。

translations.literal: At the time Chengxun had been ordered to lead the Righteous Army to Yanzhou when the Righteous Army rebelled; Chengxun fled to Binzhou; hence this punishment.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chengxun had been ordered to lead the Righteous Army to Yanzhou when the Righteous Army rebelled. Chengxun had fled to Binzhou; hence this punishment.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太原行營副招討使楊光遠殺招討使張敬達於晉安寨，以兵降契丹。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Yang Guangyuan, deputy pacification commissioner of the Taiyuan expeditionary camp, killed pacification commissioner Zhang Jingda at Jin'an camp and surrendered his troops to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Yang Guangyuan, deputy pacification commissioner of the Taiyuan expeditionary camp, killed pacification commissioner Zhang Jingda at Jin'an camp and surrendered his troops to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 時契丹圍寨，自十一月以後芻糧乏絕，軍士毀居屋茅、淘馬糞、削鬆甗以供秣飼，馬尾鬛相食俱盡。

translations.literal: At the time the Khitan besieged the camp; from the eleventh month onward fodder and grain were exhausted; soldiers tore thatch from houses, washed horse dung, and shaved pine vessels to supply feed; horses ate one another's tails and manes until nothing remained.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Khitan had besieged the camp. From the eleventh month onward fodder and grain were exhausted. Soldiers tore thatch from houses, washed horse dung, and shaved pine vessels to supply feed. Horses ate one another's tails and manes until nothing remained.

sentences.zh: 楊光遠謂敬達曰：「少時人馬俱盡，不如奮命血戰，十得三四，猶勝坐受其弊。

translations.literal: Yang Guangyuan said to Jingda: "Before long men and horses will all be gone; better to stake our lives in bloody battle—if three or four out of ten survive, that is still better than sitting and suffering defeat."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangyuan said to Jingda: "Before long men and horses will all be gone. Better to stake our lives in bloody battle. If three or four out of ten survive, that is still better than sitting here and suffering defeat."

sentences.zh: 」敬達曰：「更少待之。

translations.literal: " Jingda said: "Wait a little longer."
translations.idiomatic: " Jingda said: "Wait a little longer."

sentences.zh: 」一日，光遠伺敬達無備，遂殺之，與諸將同降契丹。

translations.literal: " One day Guangyuan watched for a moment when Jingda was unprepared, then killed him and surrendered to the Khitan together with the other generals.
translations.idiomatic: " One day Guangyuan watched for a moment when Jingda was unprepared, then killed him and surrendered to the Khitan together with the other generals.

sentences.zh: 時馬猶有五千匹，戎王主以漢軍與石敬瑭，其馬及甲仗即齎驅出塞。

translations.literal: At the time there were still five thousand horses; the barbarian ruler gave the Han army to Shi Jingtang and immediately drove their horses and armor out of the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there were still five thousand horses. The barbarian ruler gave the Han army to Shi Jingtang and immediately drove their horses and armor out of the frontier.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，戎王立石敬瑭為大晉皇帝，約為父子之國，改元為天福。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the barbarian ruler installed Shi Jingtang as Emperor of Great Jin, with an agreement of father-and-son states, and changed the era name to Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the barbarian ruler installed Shi Jingtang as Emperor of Great Jin, with an agreement of father-and-son states, and changed the era name to Tianfu.

sentences.zh: 戎王與晉高祖南行，趙德鈞父子與諸將自團柏穀南奔，王師為蕃騎所蹙，投戈棄甲，自相騰踐，擠於岩穀者不可勝紀。

translations.literal: The barbarian ruler and the Jin Founder went south; Zhao Dejun father and son and the generals fled south from Tuanbai Valley; the imperial army was pressed by barbarian horsemen, cast aside spears and abandoned armor, trampled one another in flight, and those crushed in ravines and valleys were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarian ruler and the Jin Founder went south. Zhao Dejun father and son and the generals fled south from Tuanbai Valley. The imperial army was pressed by barbarian horsemen, cast aside spears and abandoned armor, trampled one another in flight, and those crushed in ravines and valleys were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 己巳，帝聞晉安寨為敵所陷，詔移幸河陽，時議以魏府軍尚全，契丹必憚山東，未敢南下，車駕可幸鄴城。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Emperor heard that Jin'an camp had fallen to the enemy; an edict ordered removal to Heyang.
